primary_goal: Sustained write throughput close to matched raw PostgreSQL
working_target_note: On 2026-10-31 the user conditionally accepted 85% of native if more workers can compensate. Treat this as a per-writable-shard target conditional on measured aggregate scaling; read replicas do not add writers to a branch.
document_storage_goal: Optimize JSON document mutations while preserving scale-to-zero, fast wake and the accepted failure envelope; evaluate physical deltas, read amplification, transactional indexing and compaction together.
document_storage_criteria: Small patches avoid rewriting unchanged content
Small projections avoid reading unchanged content
comparison: Same data, SQL, indexes, cache profile, CPU/memory budget, storage path, compression and foreground acknowledgement policy; report any remaining asymmetry
resource_comparison_policy: User explicitly requested both on 2026-10-31: same total CPU budget, and same compute CPU with separately disclosed storage CPU. A result with extra storage CPU cannot pass the same-total-budget screen.
write_p99_role: Diagnostic only; the user explicitly removed p99 as a pass/fail requirement
performance_environment: Require matched resource/data/policy profiles and no measured S3 operation errors; degraded-storage timings are diagnostics, never a healthy native-PG baseline
failure_scope: Compute loss or one storage-node failure; block fast writes during replication outages
excluded_failure_scope: Compound destruction of remaining acknowledged tail copies during a prolonged replication outage
planned_sleep: Stop request admission, drain to external durable quorum, persist ownership/frontier handoff, then remove compute
wake_goal: Near-instant wake to usable compute; measure first durable write and cold/full-throughput recovery separately
application_compatibility: Preserve ordinary PostgreSQL SQL, JSONB, schemas and application calls; no custom document API or required SQL functions
validation_scope: One matched native PostgreSQL versus Neon write benchmark
